reachability.evidence: All three surfaces (Data API v3, Analytics API v2, Studio Innertube) are plain HTTPS endpoints. No anti-bot challenge expected; OAuth tokens and Studio cookies are the only credentials needed.

auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (refresh + access tokens) for Data + Analytics APIs. Cookie session + SAPISIDHASH-computed Authorization header for Studio Innertube. login command harvests both.
